run_novelty_analysis: run the novelty script to find structurally unique and novel materials from a prerelaxed dataframe
run_get_matches: run get_matches to find structural matches and RMS distances between a structure and alternatives
run_uniqueness_check: run the uniqueness check to find duplicate structures within a generated dataset using StructureMatcher
run_novelty_detection: run novelty detection to compare generated structures against tabular reference datasets like ICSD or MP
run_sun_material_identification: run the SUN material identification to find structures that are both unique and novel
